mission_check.capability: Use the learned battler inside an already-running game and continue from its actual earned state.
mission_check.learned_authority: Frozen J owns every battle attack, voluntary switch, replacement prompt and forced replacement. Field preparation is disclosed setup, not learned navigation.
mission_check.transfer_test: One new Super Nerd encounter per retained boot2900/3100 J timing0 endpoint, after normal-menu lead reversal. These retain the existing two origins and are not new independent roots.
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: A two-member battle fails to exercise an actual learned reserve decision, requires assistance, or cannot hand back verifiable field state.
mission_check.time_box: 45 minutes for probe, up to two hours including integration and verification.
mission_check.stop_condition: At most two encounters; no resets after initial endpoint load, replay, replacement source, state edit, fit, route hardening, full run or push. Retain failures.

selection: Timing0 J endpoints declared by source order, not best outcomes; both already verified prior session.
setup: Reuse the existing short Rocket-to-Super-Nerd traversal. Swap slots0/1 with the existing normal field-party menu at the trigger origin. Incidental setup wild encounters use existing bounded flee mechanics. No teacher trainer decisions.
probe_gate: Both episodes terminate unassisted with at least one model-selected actual switch each; at least one verified story victory. Random losses are retained and not alone a rejection.
integration: Execute each model battle in the same live emulator without a capture reset. Observe a fresh outcome ledger after success or exception. On the first qualifying winner only, use the existing post-battle control-settle mechanic, retain the exact endpoint and verify readable field control and preserved registrations/specimens. No further trainer battle or learned goal-selection claim.
completion_scope: Supported small-party trainer-battle integration v1, not universal mechanics, six-member mastery, autonomous navigation or a full Red run.
